title: Thumbnail cache
whyItMatters: Desktop file managers cache small previews of pictures, videos and documents that were viewed, in plain image files named after a hash of the original path. The cache can reveal what was browsed even after the files themselves were deleted.
source: freedesktop.org Thumbnail Managing Standard: thumbnails are cached under $XDG_CACHE_HOME/thumbnails, default ~/.cache/thumbnails: https://specifications.freedesktop.org/thumbnail-spec/latest/
notes: Normal and large sizes are separate subfolders. File names are MD5 hashes of the URI, not readable names, and some desktop environments prune old entries. Respects XDG_CACHE_HOME, which this rule does not read.

steps: Open the file manager and press Ctrl+H to show hidden files.
Delete the folder named in the plan to clear all cached preview images.
cleanup.risk: Removes cached image, video and document preview thumbnails. File managers will regenerate thumbnails on demand when folders are opened.
